problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:  
* Component A: volume 67 m³  
* Component B: volume 48 m³  
* Component C: volume 64 m³  
* Component D: volume 31 m³  
* Component E: volume 66 m³  
* Component F: volume 33 m³  
* Component G: volume 55 m³  
* Component H: volume 56 m³  
* Component I: volume 63 m³  
* Component J: volume 53 m³  
* Component K: volume 44 m³  
* Component L: volume 45 m³  
* Component M: volume 40 m³  
* Component N: volume 36 m³  
* Component O: volume 37 m³  
* Component P: volume 64 m³  
* Component Q: volume 68 m³  
* Component R: volume 39 m³  
* Component S: volume 48 m³  
* Component T: volume 52 m³  
* Component U: volume 61 m³  
* Component V: volume 62 m³  
* Component W: volume 45 m³  
* Component X: volume 57 m³  
* Component Y: volume 39 m³  
* Component Z: volume 68 m³  
* Component [: volume 68 m³  
* Component \: volume 41 m³  
* Component ]: volume 51 m³  
* Component ^: volume 41 m³  
* Component _: volume 31 m³  
* Component `: volume 51 m³  

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 m³. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be placed on exactly one plane, and the total volume on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
